name: osdfont
description: Upload an OSD .mcm font (Clarity, Bold, Default, Betaflight, Digital, Impact, Large, Vision, etc.) to a Betaflight FC over MSP. Pulls the .mcm from betaflight-configurator/resources/osd/ on GitHub, parses 256 chars × 54 bytes, writes one char per MSP_OSD_CHAR_WRITE. Analog SD (MAX7456) only.
